title.en: An Act to Provide that the Testimony of a Lessee or Tenant Shall Be Accepted, in Certain Cases, as "Prima Facie" Evidence on the Terms of His Contract With the Owner of Land.

text.en:
Where a covenant or contract made between the owner of land and a lessee or tenant on share
thereof has not been reduced to writing or has not been set forth in a document written in a language known to
the lessee or tenant, the testimony of such lessee or tenant shall be accepted as prima facie evidence on the
terms of a covenant or contract.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 17, 1936.
